title: Seasonality Trading: A Statistical Strategy for Stocks and Indices
summary: Seasonality in financial markets is commonly used by investors to identify recurring market trends over specific periods of the year. However, historical data can also be analyzed on a much shorter time horizon, potentially highlighting individual trading days in which stocks or indices have shown a statistically significant tendency to move in a particular direction.
